last_action: PERSONALITY LAYER STRIPPED on user feedback from the first real device build, recorded as DECISIONS.md D11: ask nothing that doesn't configure something. Onboarding went from seven screens to two (name, then reminders); the archetype is deleted everywhere including the backup format, which now ignores rather than rejects an archetype in older files. The same test retired plant-days (a number with no interpretation), temp (configured nothing — replaced by `location`, which makes the Garden indoor/outdoor filters work for the first time; nothing had ever set that value), and the pressing picker (asked the user to name an illustration style; now derived from the plant name). Filters that match nothing are no longer rendered, and the active filter falls back to All when it stops matching. Developer text — 'Add EXPO_PUBLIC_PERENUAL_KEY to .env' — removed from the species search, with a test asserting no screen names an env var. Thirsty cards now settle centred (the side gutter was the page padding, which does not line up with the snap interval). A watered plant holds 1.4s so the ripple plays, then drops to Upcoming — correcting an overcorrection from the day before. First run seeds ONE lived-in example plant rather than six demos. 20 suites / 224 tests, CI green. iOS PREVIEW BUILD CUT AND FINISHED — standalone, installable, ready to be lived with.
next_action: (1) Install the iOS preview build by opening its EAS build page on the phone, then USE IT. Everything left in Phase 1 is downstream of that. (2) The watering reminder has still never fired on real hardware — turn reminders on, pick the next slot ahead of the current hour, and leave the phone alone. (3) Two open items from the last feedback round, both needing eyes rather than code: whether 'Water Marcel' still looks off-centre (nothing wrong found in the code; may have been the card off-centre, now fixed), and whether the Today footer should report state ('you're caught up') rather than count plants. (4) Then: Maestro against the device, TestFlight, Play internal.

blockers.description: The watering reminder — the feature the whole app exists for — has never fired on real hardware. Everything around it is tested; delivery itself is not. The preview build makes it observable for the first time.
